s1.syndrome_frame: Chronic unilateral nasal obstruction with a polypoid mass
salient_findings: Large polypoid mass obstructing the left nasal cavity
Soft tissue polypoid density on Computed Tomographic Imaging
CD138-positive and CD56-positive on pathological analysis
key_facts: 12-month history of left-sided nasal congestion and obstruction
No response to medical treatment
Large polypoid mass obstructing the left nasal cavity on physical examination
Soft tissue polypoid density on Computed Tomographic Imaging
Mass does not involve the orbit or skull base
CD138-positive on pathological analysis
CD56-positive on pathological analysis
CD20-negative on pathological analysis
PAX5-negative on pathological analysis
EBV-positive on pathological analysis
Fluorescence in situ hybridization showed gains of florescence signal at multiple loci
No local or distant metastatic disease on additional studies

raw.syndrome_frame: Chronic unilateral nasal obstruction with a polypoid mass
salient_findings: Large polypoid mass obstructing the left nasal cavity
Soft tissue polypoid density on Computed Tomographic Imaging
CD138-positive and CD56-positive on pathological analysis
key_facts: 12-month history of left-sided nasal congestion and obstruction
No response to medical treatment
Large polypoid mass obstructing the left nasal cavity on physical examination
Soft tissue polypoid density on Computed Tomographic Imaging
Mass does not involve the orbit or skull base
CD138-positive on pathological analysis

CD20-negative on pathological analysis
PAX5-negative on pathological analysis
EBV-positive on pathological analysis
Fluorescence in situ hybridization showed gains of florescence signal at multiple loci
No local or distant metastatic disease on additional studies

raw.rationale: The presence of CD138-positive, CD56-positive, and EBV-positive markers, along with the absence of CD20 and PAX5 expression, is consistent with Extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma. The fluorescence in situ hybridization results showing gains at multiple loci also support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Plasmablastic lymphoma
rejected.why: CD20-negative and PAX5-negative results are not typical for plasmablastic lymphoma, which usually expresses these markers

rejected.label: Hemangiopericytoma
rejected.why: The immunophenotypic profile does not match hemangiopericytoma, and the presence of EBV positivity is not characteristic of this tumor

rejected.label: Juvenile nasopharyngeal angiofibroma
rejected.why: This tumor typically occurs in adolescent males and has a distinct histological appearance, which does not match the provided pathological analysis

rejected.label: Sinonasal undifferentiated carcinoma
rejected.why: The immunophenotypic profile and EBV positivity are more consistent with Extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma than sinonasal undifferentiated carcinoma
